service.name: Pilgrim's Traverse (Deep Dungeon)
service.longDescription: Beneath the verdant hills of Il Mheg, a holy road winds down into the dark. Pilgrim’s Traverse calls the faithful and the foolhardy alike to walk its ninety-nine floors, gathering offerings for the verse that waits at journey’s end.

rewards.title: Aetherpool Levels & Armour
rewards.text: Upgrades on your Aetherpool Level & Armour.

rewards.title: Tomestones & Loot
rewards.text: Various loot from acquiring and clearing the floors of the deep dungeon.

rewards.title: The Enlightened Title
rewards.text: Exclusive title achieved by completing the deep dungeon solo.

rewards.title: Achievement: “Solo Traveler II”
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon clearing Pilgrim's Traverse Floor 99 Solo.
